sql.name: filter_candidates
sql.sql:
SELECT p.id, VECTOR_TO_STRING(p.embedding) AS embeddingStr
FROM products p
LEFT JOIN product_genders g ON g.id = p.gender_id
LEFT JOIN brands b ON b.id = p.brand_id
LEFT JOIN product_types pt ON pt.id = p.product_type_id
LEFT JOIN fragrance_families ff ON ff.id = p.fragrance_family_id
LEFT JOIN scent_types st ON st.id = p.scent_type_id
WHERE p.status = 'active' AND p.embedding IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM product_variants v
      WHERE v.shopify_product_id = p.shopify_product_id
        AND (v.available_for_sale = 1 OR v.inventory_quantity > 0)
    )
